lemmy.name: Community (Lemmy)
lemmy.description: A Reddit-like community platform with threaded discussions, voting, and moderation. Federation via ActivityPub.

peertube.name: Video (PeerTube)
peertube.description: A decentralized video hosting platform. Upload, share, and livestream. Federation via ActivityPub.

mastodon.name: Social (Mastodon)
mastodon.description: A microblogging platform similar to Twitter/X. Full ActivityPub federation with the fediverse.
